forward_policy: Fix newly observed gaps at the point of detection.
Never mutate historical Winner/Survivor records under this baseline.
Never change historical thresholds to improve a future result.
Decision journal uses a single-writer critical section for duplicate-check plus append.
Malformed existing journal content causes fail-closed refusal to append.
Decision append is fsync-backed before returning success.
Outcome is immutable relative to the decision record and must use a separate artifact.
No live execution is enabled by this baseline.
quality_gate: collector execution remains disabled until separately authorized
